messages:
maria: Heads up — after yesterday's KMS rewrap, we started seeing a spike where embeddings-scoped keys are being accepted by chat routes for a handful of customers. Not a full-blown outage but definitely wrong.
ajay: ack. Any repro steps or logs? which service is returning allow for chat?
dylan: saw this in SRE logs:
```
authz_check: token=tok_*** route=/v1/chat model=gpt-open-1 result=ALLOW scope=scopes:[\"embeddings.create\"]
```
that log line is the smoking gun — the scope checker returned ALLOW even though route requires chat.* scopes.
maria: exact. I grep'd older logs and it looks correlated with the KMS rewrap that changed key tag metadata on ~22:10 UTC. Possibly the authz cache still had old tag mapping and we treat missing tag as permissive.
sec-bot: automated alert: incident suspected: scope-enforcement-regression. Priority=P2. Linked runbook: /runbooks/authz-cache-rotate
ajay: quick hypothesis: during rewrap we momentarily returned a default policy when tag lookup failed. There was an RBAC refactor last month that changed fallback semantics (fail-open -> fail-neutral). sylvie: that refactor was deliberate for internal services to avoid user-facing 5xx, but we didn't gate it behind the per-route allowlist logic.
opsbot: repro steps from QA: 1) rewrap key using kms rewrap API 2) send embedding request using old token 3) observe chat route accepted. Repro rate ~3/1000 requests for a few minutes.
dylan: additional log excerpt showing tag mismatch:
```
kms_meta_fetch: key_id=k-123 tag=env:prod -> tag_missing=true
authz_cache_lookup: key_id=k-123 tags=[] -> policy_fallback=DEFAULT_ALLOW
```
maria: what about audit logs? do we have request-level evidence so we can notify impacted customers and rotate their affected tokens?
ajay: audit events show route called and payloads, but the audit entry doesn't include the key tag or authz decision reason. We should enrich audit log with `authz_reason` and `kms_key_tag` for postmortem.
sylvie: for immediate mitigation I propose: 1) revert the refactor's fail-neutral behavior back to fail-closed for external routes (embeddings/chat) 2) invalidate authz cache entries when key metadata changes (on rewrap webhook) 3) push a small audit-enrichment patch.
dylan: agree. Can we hotfix (1) quickly? Where is the flag? ajay: it's `AUTHZ_FALLBACK_MODE` in platform-config. We can set to `fail-closed` for prod via feature-flag rollout. I can do a staged flip (canary -> 10% -> 100%) and monitor.
maria: assign owners: ajay for feature flag flip + canary, dylan for cache invalidation patch, sylvie for audit log enrichment and customer comms template.
sec-bot: suggested timeline: canary flip in 15m, patch PR for cache invalidation in ~2h, audit patch in ~3h, customer-notify draft in 4h.
ajay: canary flip live now. Monitoring dashboards: authz.allow_rate for chat routes dropping to baseline. will report in 5.
dylan: starting local repro + PR for `authz-cache` to watch kms tag change events and evict keys. small change: subscribe to `kms.key.rewrap` and call `authz_cache.invalidate(key_id)`.
sylvie: customer comms draft: short, transparent, timeline, recommended remediation (rotate token). I'll post to #support for signoff.
maria: what about retro/follow-up? we need an ops playbook entry: always invalidate authz cache on any KMS rewrap/rekey and include tag in audit logs so post-rotate queries are deterministic.
ajay: confirmed canary stable. no increase in 5xx. authz.allow_rate for chat dropped. moving to 10%.
sec-bot: incident state -> mitigated. tagging for postmortem.
opsbot: NOTE: created issue INFRA-4821 to add KMS->authz webhook and audit enrichment. Linked PRs: authz-cache#412, audit-logs#79, platform-config#210.
maria: thanks everyone. dylan/sylvie please coordinate the postmortem doc and include suggested test matrix (simulate rewrap with missing tags, verify fail-closed semantics, verify audit fields present). I'll loop in legal if any compliance impact.
ajay: one more thing — let's also add an e2e regression test to CI that runs a fake rewrap and asserts no scope escalation.
dylan: yep adding that to tests/authz/regress.
sec-bot: closing thread summary: root cause: RBAC refactor changed fallback semantics + missing kms tag on some rewrapped keys -> transient authz allow. Mitigation: flip fallback -> fail-closed, invalidate cache on rewrap, enrich audit logs. Owners assigned. Postmortem required. :white_check_mark:
